source.title: More Greater Moonstones
source.description: We still need more Greater Moonstones to reverse the Nightmare Incursions. Travel through the Emerald Portal in Dream Bough and bring me back some.
source.objective: Gather 10 Greater Moonstones in the Feralas Nightmare Incursions and return to Field Captain Arunnel.
source.completion: Well done! Thank you. Your services will be remembered.
